answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with net-value standing: rank counts only value flowing in from outside a head's payment clique, so a farm's circular task-payments net to zero on the ledger. Honest heads sell real work to unrelated buyers and keep every pearl of earned standing. The farm's haven of mutual back-scratching manufactures nothing — an opal's fire dies under a single lamp. To gain rank it must genuinely sell to outsiders, and then it is a business, not an attack.
